text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: You're in quite a good mood.
You're in quite a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You know what? Yesterday, I went to 
the mall with some classmates!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Among them was this wonderful clothing 
shop with cute ruffles and ribbons... 
Everything was so adorable, I couldn't 
keep my eyes in one place!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And you know... I found a shop with 
clothes that would look perfect on you, 
Trainer. If you'd like, want to go check 
it out together sometime?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to buy it if you don't like 
it, so how about just trying it on? ...I'm 
certain it'll look great on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She directs an ardent, expectant gaze this 
way... Whether I take her up on the offer 
can be decided later; for now, it seems 
she enjoyed her day off.
